title: Alejandro Velázquez — Lead product designer, open banking
description: Product design lead at Yapily. Hosted Pages, the customer Console, three design systems and a six-year UX research practice in regulated open banking.

title: About — Alejandro Velázquez
description: Twenty years in product design, six of them building the design function at Yapily. How I work, who I have worked with, and what I am looking for next.

title: Yapily Hosted Pages — case study
description: The white-label bank-connection and consent flow used by 200 companies. Three years of research, over forty variants, and the findings that turned out not to be screen problems.

title: The Yapily Console — case study
description: Six years of a tool built for one customer type, deprioritised, then rebuilt so customers can onboard, configure and pay without a conversation.

title: Yapily UI, Custard and Mark — case study
description: Three design systems for three different consumers: internal tools, a white-label configurator, and the marketing site — plus the governance behind them.

title: HeadBox — inverting a marketplace
description: An event-space marketplace converting at 10%. The expertise was on the wrong side of the transaction — inverting it changed the revenue model and produced £150,288 ARR in three months.

title: Research practice — Alejandro Velázquez
description: Building and running a UX research practice with no researcher: two hundred customer conversations, hundreds of usability sessions and an experimentation pipeline.

title: Creative archive — Alejandro Velázquez
description: Illustration, comics, printmaking and character work — the visual practice underneath twenty years of product design.
